name: @w6w-apps/zoho-workdrive
description: Manage Zoho WorkDrive files, folders, team folders, search and share links.

w6w.longDescription:
Zoho WorkDrive puts a team file store into a workflow: list teams and team members, browse and create team folders and folders, list a folder's contents, read file metadata and versions, rename, move, copy, trash, restore or permanently delete files and folders, upload a file, search a team by name and content, and create, list and revoke external download links.

Zoho hosts every account in one of nine regional data centres, each with its own sign-in endpoint, so this app routes each region through its own dedicated connection rather than one that could send a request to the wrong region.

Chunked uploads over 250 MB, binary downloads, workflows, data templates, collections, comments, groups, labels and member sharing are deliberately left out.
